nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) tracking token balances held by each account.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) storing spender allowances granted by owners.
Private uint256 holding the total amount of tokens in existence.
Private string storing the ERC20 token name, set once in the ERC20 constructor.
Private string storing the ERC20 token symbol, set once in the ERC20 constructor.
Private constant string identifying the generator URL; immutable compile-time value.
Private string storing the generator version, written in the GeneratorCopyright constructor.
Payable token constructor: validates non-zero initial supply, forwards fee to ServicePayer and mints the entire initial balance to the deployer.
Internal function creating tokens, increasing _totalSupply and the recipient balance before emitting Transfer from the zero address.
Internal function moving tokens between accounts: validates addresses and balance, debits sender and credits recipient.
Public ERC20 transfer that delegates to _transfer with _msgSender() as the sender.
Public ERC20 transferFrom: moves tokens via _transfer then reduces the caller's allowance after a balance check.
Public ERC20 approve that delegates to _approve with _msgSender() as the owner.
Internal function writing the allowance mapping for an owner/spender pair after zero-address validation.
Public function atomically increasing a spender allowance for the caller via _approve.
Public function atomically decreasing a spender allowance for the caller, guarded by a lower-bound require.
Internal function destroying tokens from an account, reducing its balance and _totalSupply.
Internal view returning msg.sender, used to abstract the transaction origin for meta-transaction awareness.
Payable constructor that performs an external call to IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) to pay a service fee.
Public view returning the balance stored in _balances for an account.
Public view returning the allowance stored in _allowances for an owner/spender pair.
Public view returning the value of _totalSupply.
Virtual hook invoked before every mint, transfer and burn; empty by default but overridable, making it a callback surface.
Caller-supplied address; reaches the contract through _msgSender, transfer, approve, transferFrom and both allowance mutators.
External payable call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) executed inside the constructor with an attacker-influenced target address.
State-changing subtraction _balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount that mutates the balance ledger after the hook callback.
State-changing addition _totalSupply += amount that increases the supply and the recipient balance.
State-changing subtraction _approve(sender, _msgSender(), currentAllowance - amount) reducing the caller allowance.
State-changing subtraction currentAllowance - subtractedValue applied after the lower-bound require.
State-changing subtractions _balances[account] = accountBalance - amount and _totalSupply -= amount.
Constructor string argument forwarded to the ERC20 constructor as the token name.
Constructor string argument forwarded to the ERC20 constructor as the token symbol.
Constructor uint256 checked to be greater than zero and minted to the deployer.
Payable address of the fee receiver, passed to ServicePayer and used as the external call target.
Address whose balance is debited during a transfer; validated against the zero address.
Address credited during a transfer; validated against the zero address.
Token amount moved in the transfer and subtracted from the sender balance.
Beneficiary address receiving newly minted tokens; validated against the zero address.
Quantity of tokens created and added to the total supply.
Owner of the tokens being moved by transferFrom.
Recipient of the tokens moved by transferFrom.
Amount transferred and deducted from the spender allowance.
Address authorised to spend the caller tokens.
Allowance value written for the spender.
Token owner whose allowance mapping entry is written; validated against the zero address.
Spender address granted the allowance; validated against the zero address.
Allowance amount stored in the nested mapping.
Recipient of the tokens in the public transfer entry point.
Amount transferred in the public transfer entry point.
Spender whose allowance is increased.
Value added to the current spender allowance.
Spender whose allowance is decreased.
Value subtracted from the current spender allowance after a lower-bound require.
Account whose tokens are destroyed; validated against the zero address.
Quantity of tokens destroyed from the account.
Cached sender balance read from _balances before the subtraction.
Cached allowance of the caller for the sender before deduction.
Cached caller allowance for the spender before deduction.
Cached account balance read from _balances before burning.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read and returned by Context._msgSender, the only trusted wrapper for the caller identity.
The value returned by _msgSender() determines the beneficiary of the full initial supply mint in the SimpleERC20 constructor.
The constructor invokes _mint(_msgSender(), initialBalance_) after validating the initial supply.
The constructor runs the ServicePayer base constructor through the ServicePayer(feeReceiver_, "SimpleERC20") modifier.
The name_ argument flows through the ERC20 base constructor into the _name state variable.
The symbol_ argument flows through the ERC20 base constructor into the _symbol state variable.
_mint performs the unchecked-style _totalSupply += amount supply increase.
_mint credits the recipient entry of the _balances mapping.
_mint invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances, a callback re-entry point.
_transfer computes _balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount, the only balance mutation in the transfer path.
_transfer writes both the sender and recipient entries of the _balances mapping.
_transfer calls the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook prior to any balance mutation.
The public transfer function delegates all movement of tokens to _transfer.
transferFrom first moves tokens through the internal _transfer function before adjusting the allowance.
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] into the currentAllowance local variable.
transferFrom subtracts amount from currentAllowance and rewrites the allowance through _approve.
transferFrom calls the internal _approve to persist the reduced allowance.
The public approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
increaseAllowance calls _approve with the current allowance plus addedValue.
decreaseAllowance reads _allowances[_msgSender()][spender] into the currentAllowance local variable.
decreaseAllowance computes currentAllowance - subtractedValue before writing the new allowance.
decreaseAllowance calls _approve to persist the reduced allowance.
_approve is the sole writer of the nested _allowances mapping.
_burn removes the burned amount from the account entry of _balances.
_burn executes _balances[account] = accountBalance - amount and _totalSupply -= amount.
_burn calls the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before reducing balances and supply.
The ServicePayer constructor forwards msg.value through the external IPayable(receiver).pay call.
feeReceiver_ is cast to IPayable and used as the callee, so the constructor-time external call target is supplied at deployment.
transfer uses msg.sender (via _msgSender) as the debited account.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is checked and reduced.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
_approve receives msg.sender as owner (from approve/transferFrom) or as spender (from the allowance mutators).
increaseAllowance reads and writes the allowance of msg.sender.
decreaseAllowance reads and writes the allowance of msg.sender.
balanceOf returns the value stored in the _balances mapping.
allowance returns the value stored in the nested _allowances mapping.
totalSupply returns the _totalSupply state variable.
The sender parameter is the externally supplied address whose balance is debited inside _transfer.
The externally supplied amount parameter is the operand subtracted in the balance update.
The mint amount parameter is added to _totalSupply and to the recipient balance.
The transferFrom amount parameter is subtracted from the caller allowance.
The subtractedValue parameter is the operand of the allowance subtraction.
The cached senderBalance local variable is the minuend of the balance subtraction.
The cached accountBalance local variable is the minuend of the burn subtraction.

normalization_plan.reason: The name_ parameter only feeds the ERC20 base constructor of the SimpleERC20 constructor and has no standalone semantics.
The symbol_ parameter only feeds the ERC20 base constructor of the SimpleERC20 constructor.
initialBalance_ is validated and immediately minted inside the SimpleERC20 constructor.
feeReceiver_ is the target address of the external IPayable.pay call, the constructor-time unsafe operation.
The sender parameter is consumed only by the _transfer balance-debit logic.
The recipient parameter is consumed only by the _transfer balance-credit logic.
The amount parameter resolves directly into the _transfer balance subtraction.
The account parameter is the sole beneficiary of the _mint balance credit.
The mint amount parameter resolves directly into the _totalSupply addition.
The sender parameter is consumed only by the transferFrom allowance and transfer path.
The recipient parameter is forwarded from transferFrom into _transfer.
The transferFrom amount parameter is the operand of the allowance subtraction.
The spender parameter is forwarded from approve into _approve.
The amount parameter is forwarded from approve into _approve.
The owner parameter is written into the _allowances mapping inside _approve.
The spender parameter indexes the _allowances mapping inside _approve.
The amount parameter is the value stored in _allowances inside _approve.
The recipient parameter is forwarded from transfer into _transfer.
The amount parameter is forwarded from transfer into _transfer.
The spender parameter indexes the allowance entry read and written by increaseAllowance.
The addedValue parameter is the increment applied to the spender allowance.
The spender parameter indexes the allowance entry read and written by decreaseAllowance.
The subtractedValue parameter resolves directly into the decreaseAllowance subtraction.
The account parameter is the sole target of the _burn balance and supply reduction.
The amount parameter is the operand removed from both the balance and the total supply in _burn.
senderBalance is a temporary read of _balances used exclusively as the minuend of the _transfer subtraction.
currentAllowance is a temporary read of _allowances used exclusively as the minuend of the transferFrom allowance subtraction.
currentAllowance is a temporary read of _allowances used exclusively as the minuend of the decreaseAllowance subtraction.
accountBalance is a temporary read of _balances used exclusively as the minuend of the _burn subtraction.
